about: Golden findings for the review regression harness (#509). Real defects come from injected defects of the synthetic corpus (#415) and from reproductions written by hand for the #509 audit; none comes from the verifier under test. Each must survive every deterministic layer. Known false alarms must still be caught. Add human-verified records here as they accumulate.

files.crypto/known_hosts.py:
from pathlib import Path


def append_entry(path: Path, line: str) -> None:
    path.parent.mkdir(mode=0o777, parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with path.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        handle.write(line)
files.playbooks/cluster_backup.yaml:
- hosts: backup
  tasks:
    - name: Create the backup directory
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: /srv/backup
        state: directory
        mode: "0777"

  tasks:

files.core/process.py:
import asyncio


async def run(proc, timeout):
    stdout, stderr = asyncio.wait_for(proc.communicate(), timeout)
    return stdout

real_defects.title: safe_resolve_subpath allows traversal outside base_dir
real_defects.description: No containment check follows resolve(); `../` segments escape base_dir. Symlink rejection does not stop them.

real_defects.title: Missing inheritance depth limit in load_policy
real_defects.description: The `load_policy` function accepts a `_depth` parameter but never enforces CONST_SUPPRESSION_MAX_INHERITANCE_DEPTH, so a long extends chain recurses without bound.

real_defects.title: Insecure directory creation permissions in append_entry
real_defects.description: The parent directory of known_hosts is created with mode 0o777.

real_defects.title: Backup directory created world-writable (0777)
real_defects.description: The backup directory is created with mode 0777.

real_defects.title: Unpinned image tag nvidia/cuda:latest
real_defects.description: The smoke test pulls a moving tag.

real_defects.title: HTTP POST helper does not validate response status
real_defects.description: `_post` parses the body of any response, so a 403 or 500 is treated as data.

real_defects.title: Audit log destination from environment is not validated
real_defects.description: AUDIT_LOG_DEST is resolved without a containment check.

real_defects.title: wait_for coroutine is never awaited
real_defects.description: `asyncio.wait_for` is called without await, so the timeout never applies.

real_defects.title: SQL injection via f-string
real_defects.description: The f-string syntax interpolates the search term into the SQL query.

real_defects.title: Bare `except` clause swallows KeyboardInterrupt
real_defects.description: The bare except clause catches everything, including KeyboardInterrupt.

real_defects.title: Expired tokens are processed as valid
real_defects.description: Naive and aware timestamps are compared, so expiry never applies.

real_defects.title: Authorization bypass in allowed
real_defects.description: If none of the roles match, the loop falls through to return True.

real_defects.title: Rate limiter not properly implemented for bursts
real_defects.description: Every request is allowed.

real_defects.title: Clients of the API need to send the token in the query string
real_defects.description: Tokens in query strings reach access logs.

real_defects.title: Live AWS key committed
real_defects.description: `api_key=<masked-api-key>` is a live credential, not a placeholder.

real_defects.title: Hardcoded password in test configuration
real_defects.description: A real staging password is committed.

real_defects.title: CWE-400: unbounded read_text() of user-uploaded file
real_defects.description: handle_upload reads an attacker-supplied file with no size cap.

real_defects.title: `system_prompt` may be unbound (UnboundLocalError) when the list is empty
real_defects.description: If items is empty the loop never assigns system_prompt.

real_defects.title: NameError: undefined variable `timeout` in retry
real_defects.description: `timeout` is not defined anywhere in the module.

real_defects.title: delete request sent without authentication
real_defects.description: No Authorization header is sent by delete.

real_defects.title: Looks good overall, but token is logged in plaintext
real_defects.description: The login token is printed.

real_defects.title: Token printed during login
real_defects.description: login prints the token to stdout.

real_defects.title: Unvalidated module constant
real_defects.description: The line number is past the end of the file, as a model's own count can be.

known_hallucinations.title: Syntax error: invalid Python 2 syntax in except clause
known_hallucinations.description: except ValueError, TypeError: is invalid syntax.

known_hallucinations.title: Missing `helper` function
known_hallucinations.description: `helper` is not defined in this module.

known_hallucinations.title: Syntax error: unquoted placeholder <masked-secret>
known_hallucinations.description: Unresolved identifier found in code snippet.

known_hallucinations.title: StrEnum import is incompatible with Python 3.10
known_hallucinations.description: On Python 3.10 the import raises ImportError.

known_hallucinations.title: Path.resolve() raises FileNotFoundError
known_hallucinations.description: resolve() raises FileNotFoundError when the path does not exist.
